This is the second Koala in as many months in the same spot - definitely different one because of different markings on its bottom
The koala I sighted was a large adult (so presumably male) that looked (to my untrained eye at least) healthy and strong.
The koala was fairly small, maybe 30cm from bottom to top of head. I noticed it as I heard the rustling in the ground debris of the tree as it ran to the tree. I believe it's a type of gum tree.
Seemed young but in good health, right next to main road. Bells Pocket Strathpine
